issue_description:

It crosses numerous side streets and commercial driveways.  Car drivers turning in or out don't expect bicycles on what looks like a sidewalk.

The previous configuration had perfectly usable bike lanes.

Please do not add cycle tracks to any more streets in Cambridge.

issue_type: Lights  at St. Peter's Field on Overnight
issue_description:
Hello,

My name is Galen and I’ve been living near Danehy Park/St. Peter's Feld for the last several years.

Each night — particularly over the past year — I’ve noticed that the lights in the baseball field across from Cadbury Commons are kept on well into the evening hours, even when nobody is using the field. Upon reading more about the effects these lights have on migrating birds — particularly in spring — I am wondering if city would consider turning them off unless there is an actual need (baseball game, for instance). After reading various posts about this on the neighborhood’s NextDoor pages, it appears to be of vital interest to many other residents, too.

If the lights are on to prevent crime or other wrongdoing, surely there is a better way to use the city’s resources in a way that both saves electricity and the lives of thousands of birds while still keeping the area safe.

I look forward to hearing back from you. Thank you for all you do to keep the city clean, functioning,...
